blocks.text: Like the previous sûrah, this Medinian sûrah is a supplication against the *evil of humans and jinn. This final sûrah emphasizes the fact that Allah is* the Lord and Master of all and that He is the only One to be called upon for *help, which connects full circle with the central theme of the first sûrah of* the Quran.
In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful
Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind,
from the evil of the lurking whisperer—
who whispers into the hearts of humankind—
